errors.what: First version of the fallbacks (HTOI look-alike, card line without a repeat condition) scored 193 on shard 2, below main's 196
errors.fix: compared per-receipt gained/lost lists, dropped HTOI, required the card amount printed twice; 202 with none lost

doc_friction.issue: The hook that blocks foreground sleep also blocks a single `sleep 50` before a quick check; the cloud-session notes could say to use an until-loop in run_in_background from the start.

Says RapidOCR runs at about 8 min per 233 photos on 4 cores; here it was about 20 to 30 min per split with other jobs on the box. Plan the OCR of all dev splits as a long background job, or read only the splits you need.

deviations.why: Re-reading all four dev splits (760 photos) for a no-regression check would have taken over two hours of OCR
deviations.did: Re-read val and test only (300 photos) and compared main against the change on the same readings; train 0 and 1 not re-read
deviations.result: val 138 -> 140 and test 136 -> 137, 0 lost on either; train 0/1 unchecked

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
